exactness_argument: M-A solves every component against the PARENT's sealed evidence, so a solved tensor does not depend on what else is installed and the composed child is a function of the SET.  A candidate installed after the base therefore equals the child a full run on the union recipe would build, and the base is restored exactly by writing the parent's own tensors back.
not_a_gate: Drift chooses the ORDER of the search and never the verdict.  Every lane this probe prices is still built and still read by the frozen 15-prompt review; MXO3 is alive at drift 0.4618 against a nominal 0.3765 budget, so the law's residuals are not a licence to refuse a child a reading.
purpose: Wave 13 lane shopping: the marginal composed drift of one candidate lane -- SwiGLU triple or M5 attention head merge -- installed on a fixed base, every candidate against the same base in one process, optionally repeated as a greedy ladder.
